0.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Fulmination could not be cast in Tree of Wrath.

[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Overheated Strikes] - Overheated Strikes damaging proc is now treated as a melee ability instead of a spell. This means it will scale with melee crit modifiers and critically strike for 200% of its normal damage.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Corrected an issue where Phoenix's Ember Blasts may had not enough range to cover the entire platform.

[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Corrected an issue where Phoenix's  self inflicted Burn damage would scale with their own damage modifiers, eventually killing them at an increased rate, leading to more Ember Blasts.

[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Corrected an issue where Water Elementals spawning from the North East side of the room would "swim" on land, causing them to "run" at a much higher swimming speed then other Elementals correctly "walking" up to Lady Vashj.
[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Corrected an issue where Lady Vashj may fail to acknowledge a player standing in the Anti Magic Zone.

[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Coilfang Parasites now use the Seek Prey mechanic to lock on their targets, making it much more visible who is attacked and allows them to smart select their prey target. Coilfang Parasites - Parasitic Infection no longer inflicts health percentage damage. Parasitic Infection now inflicts a set amount of Nature damage every second. Parasitic Infection now obeys all forms of effects that would increase or reduce magic damage.

[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Parasitic Shot no longer inflicts health percentage damage. Parasitic Shot now inflicts a set amount of Nature damage every second. Parasitic Shot now obeys all forms of effects that would increase or reduce magic damage.

[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Reduced the radius of Sonic Boom to 3 yards down from 8. Sonic Boom is now considered Physical damage and will obey armor and any other effect increasing or reducing Physical damage.

[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Aimed Shot has been reworked. Aimed Shots damage will now scale with the number of player inside the raid. Any number of player can now soak the damage inflicted by Aimed Shot, however each player hit no longer takers damage from Aimed Shot itself, instead the split damage is dealt as the abilities Sonic Boom damage. Any damage remaining when the Arrow hits the primary target will inflicted as the Aimed Shots damage instead of a Sonic Boom on the primary target. Aimed Shot now has a visual indicator, fitting the actual size of the line effect player can/have to stand in in order to soak damage with Sonic Boom. If only a single target is hit by Aimed Shot, Aimed Shot damage is largely increased. Aimed Shot can't be prevented. Aimed Shot now obeys all forms of damage reduction.
[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Lady Vashj will now smart select targets for her spell casts, being able to distinguish tanks from healer and dps player.

[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: The following spells are now considered Magic damage and will be effected by anything that would lower or increase Magic damage: Static Shock, Toxic Spores, Ember Blast.

[Pending Restart] [Serpent Shrine Cavern] [Lady Vashj]: Corrected several issues where spells casted by Lady Vashj and her summons would not obey different types of damage reduction such as percentage modifiers, resistances, armor.
[Pending Restart] [All Dungeons, All Raids]:  Corrected multiple issues across all dungeons and raids where bosses and creatures with self damage inflicting mechanics dealt more damage then intended.
